people.name: Jehoshaphat
people.line: Son of Asa, king of Judah.

translations.web: But Jehoshaphat said, “Isn’t there here a prophet of Yahweh, that we may inquire of him?”
translations.bsb: But Jehoshaphat asked, “Is there not still a prophet of the LORD here of whom we can inquire?”
translations.kjv: And Jehoshaphat said, Is there not here a prophet of the LORD besides, that we might enquire of him?
translations.asv: But Jehoshaphat said, Is there not here a prophet of Jehovah besides, that we may inquire of him?
